# Load


```{r output=FALSE}
# Libraries and Parameters and data
# ========================================================================================================================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(assertthat)) # for some assert statements
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(cowplot))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggh4x))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(latex2exp))

theme_set(theme_cowplot() +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5),
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = .5),
                  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = 'black'),
                  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                  panel.grid.major = element_blank()))


# === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === 
# parameters
DEVICE                = 'macbook'
# AYZW_setting_name     = 'denseSmall'
AYZW_setting_name     = 'small2'

source('../PATHS.R') # load in data_dir and save_dir and CODE_DIR, depending on DEVICE value
save_dir = paste0(save_dir, "/3_L45glutcells")
# --- Folder ---
plot_dir = sprintf('%s/AY/%s/plots/', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name)
dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive=FALSE)

# === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === === 


# setup colors/factors/etc...
# ========================================================================================================================================================================
# numNCs = c(1, 3, 5, 10, 15)
numNCs = c(1, 3, 5, 8, 10, 15)


method_long_order = c('lmYANANA', 'nbYAUNANA', 
                      'deseq2NANA',
                      'causarrayNANA',
                      paste0('proximallinear',           'PCA_UntrtCells', numNCs), 
                      paste0('proximallinear',             'PCA_MixCells', numNCs), 
                      paste0('proximallinear',               'singlegene', numNCs),
                      paste0('proximallinear',  'singlegene_housekeeping', numNCs),
                      paste0('proximalnegbin',           'PCA_UntrtCells', numNCs),
                      paste0('proximalnegbin',             'PCA_MixCells', numNCs), 
                      paste0('proximalnegbin',               'singlegene', numNCs),
                      paste0('proximalnegbin',  'singlegene_housekeeping', numNCs))
method_long_nicenames = c("Lin Reg", "Neg Bin", 
                          'deseq2', 
                      'causarray',
                      paste0('Prox Lin: PCA cntrl cells (#NC=',           numNCs, ')'), 
                      paste0('Prox Lin: PCA mix cells (#NC=',           numNCs, ')'),
                      paste0('Prox Lin: singlegene (#NC=',    numNCs, ')'),
                      paste0('Prox Lin: singlegene houskeeping (#NC=',    numNCs, ')'),
                      paste0('Prox NegBin: PCA cntrl cells (#NC=',        numNCs, ')'), 
                      paste0('Prox NegBin: PCA mix cells (#NC=',        numNCs, ')'), 
                      paste0('Prox NegBin: singlegene (#NC=', numNCs, ')'),
                      paste0('Prox NegBin: singlegene housekeeping (#NC=', numNCs, ')')
                      )
method_long_colors = c('red3','darkorange1','pink', 'chartreuse1', # lm, nb, deseq2, causarray
                       # proximallinear
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'aquamarine4'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)], # PCA cntrl cells
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'darkseagreen3'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)], # PCA mix cells cells
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'dodgerblue4'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)], # singlegene
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'steelblue4'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)], # singlegene houskeeping
                       # proximalnegbin
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'maroon3'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)],     # PCA cntrl cells
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'deeppink2'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)],     # PCA mix cells cells
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'darkorchid4'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)], # singlegene
                       colorRampPalette(c('white', 'purple2'))(length(numNCs) + 2)[3:(length(numNCs)+2)] # singlegene houskeeping
                       )
names(method_long_colors) = method_long_nicenames






get_AY_test_type2 <- function(grna_name, gene_name) {
  # negative if 'Non_target' is in grna_name
  if(grepl('Non_target', grna_name)) {return('negative')} 
  else if(grna_name == gene_name) {return('positive')} 
  else {return('discovery')}
}

# For now, only keep the AY tests chosen in AY for causarray and deseq2 so that we compare the same set of tests
# load chosen AYZW names
AY   = read.csv(sprintf('%s/AY/%s/AY.csv', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name))




# load proximal
# ========================================================================================================================================================================

if('effects.csv' %in% list.files(sprintf('%s/AY/%s/', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name))) {
  effects_prox = read.csv(sprintf('%s/AY/%s/effects.csv', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name))
} else {
  # assemble together if not done yet
  intermediateATEs_folder = sprintf('%s/AY/%s/intermediateATEs/', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name)
  effects_prox = NULL
  for(fn in list.files(intermediateATEs_folder)) {
    effects_prox = rbind(effects_prox, read.csv(sprintf('%s/%s', intermediateATEs_folder, fn)))
  }
  # update AY to only these finished
  AY = merge(AY, effects_prox |> select(grna, gene) |> distinct())
}



# # assemble together if not done yet
# prox_intermediate_ATE_fns = list.files(sprintf('%s/AY/%s/intermediateATEs/', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name))
# prox_intermediate_ATE_fns_ordered = as.integer(gsub(pattern = '[^0-9]',replacement =  '', x = prox_intermediate_ATE_fns))
# names(prox_intermediate_ATE_fns_ordered) = prox_intermediate_ATE_fns
# prox_intermediate_ATE_fns_ordered = names(sort(prox_intermediate_ATE_fns_ordered))
# effects_prox = NULL
# for(fn in prox_intermediate_ATE_fns_ordered[1:200]) {
#   effects_prox = rbind(effects_prox, 
#                        read.csv(sprintf('%s/AY/%s/intermediateATEs/%s', save_dir, AYZW_setting_name, fn)))
# }

effects_prox = merge(effects_prox, AY, all.x=TRUE) 
effects_prox = effects_prox |> dplyr::relocate(type, .after='gene')

max_prox_n_trtmnt =  effects_prox |> filter(type == 'positive') |> pull(n_trtmnt) |> max()
min_prox_n_trtmnt =  effects_prox |> filter(type == 'positive') |> pull(n_trtmnt) |> min()




# load causarray
# ========================================================================================================================================================================
INCLUDE_CAUSARRAY = TRUE
if(INCLUDE_CAUSARRAY) {
  # read in the previously formatted relevant rows when creating the AY pairs (2.3_xxx.r)
  # effects_causarray = read.csv(sprintf('%s/causarray/LFC.csv', save_dir)) 
  effects_causarray = read.csv(sprintf('%s/causarray/jin2025_L45Glut/min_counts40/lfc.csv', save_dir)) 
  
  effects_causarray = effects_causarray |>
    dplyr::rename(pval = pvalue, estimate = log2fc, se = log2fc_se, gene = gene_names, grna=trt, n_trtmnt=n_treated, n_cntrl=n_control) |>
    dplyr::select(grna, gene, estimate, se, pval, padj, rej, n_trtmnt, n_cntrl, count_treated, count_control) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(time_sec = NA, NC_type = NA,
                  numNC = NA, method='causarray'
                  )
  
  effects_causarray$type = mapply(FUN = get_AY_test_type2, grna_name = effects_causarray$grna, gene_name = effects_causarray$gene)
  effects_causarray = effects_causarray |> relocate(type, .after=gene)
  effects_causarray_all = effects_causarray
  
  # effects_causarray_all = effects_causarray_all |> mutate(type_bool = (grna==gene),
  #                                                 type = sapply(type_bool, get_AY_test_type), .after=gene) |>
  #                     select(-type_bool)
  # effects_causarray = merge(AY, effects_causarray, by = c('grna', 'gene')) # AY adds test type
  
  
  effects_causarray = merge(AY|>select(grna, gene), effects_causarray, by = c('grna', 'gene')) # select same positive and disc tests
  effects_causarray = rbind(effects_causarray, effects_causarray_all |> 
                              filter(type == 'negative') |> 
                              filter((n_trtmnt <= max_prox_n_trtmnt*1.05) & (n_trtmnt >= min_prox_n_trtmnt*.95)) |>
                              slice_sample(n=sum(AY$type=='negative'))) # add back negative tests

} else {
  effects_causarray = NULL
}


# load DESeq2
# ========================================================================================================================================================================
# read in the previously formatted relevant rows when creating the AY pairs (2.3_xxx.r)
# INCLUDE_DESEQ2 = FALSE
INCLUDE_DESEQ2 = TRUE
if(INCLUDE_DESEQ2) {
  effects_deseq = read.csv(sprintf('%s/deseq2/deseq_effects.csv', save_dir)) 

  effects_deseq = effects_deseq |>
    dplyr::rename(pval = pvalue, estimate = log2FoldChange, se = lfcSE) |>
    dplyr::select(grna, gene, estimate, se, pval) |> 
    dplyr::mutate(time_sec = NA, NC_type = NA,
                  numNC = NA, method='deseq2'
                  )
  effects_deseq$type = mapply(FUN = get_AY_test_type2, grna_name = effects_deseq$grna, gene_name = effects_deseq$gene)
  effects_deseq = effects_deseq |> relocate(type, .after=gene)
  effects_deseq_all = effects_deseq # keep original
  
  
  # effects_deseq = merge(AY, effects_deseq, by = c('grna', 'gene')) # AY adds test type
  
  
  effects_deseq = merge(AY|>select(grna, gene), effects_deseq, by = c('grna', 'gene')) # select same positive and disc tests
  effects_deseq = rbind(effects_deseq, effects_deseq_all |> filter(type == 'negative') |> slice_sample(n=sum(AY$type=='negative'))) # add
} else {
  effects_deseq = NULL
}



# assemble together
# ========================================================================================================================================================================
# bind GLM&Proximal  and  causarray  and deseq2
effects = dplyr::bind_rows(effects_prox, effects_causarray, effects_deseq)


# format method_long: ordering and nicenames
effects = effects |> 
             mutate(method_long_raw = paste0(method, NC_type, numNC),
                        method_long = factor(method_long_raw, levels = method_long_order, labels = method_long_nicenames))

# format AY test type: ordering and nicenames
effects$type = factor(effects$type,
       levels = c('negative', 'discovery', 'positive'),
       labels = c(    'Null', 'Discovery', 'Alternative'))


# remove tests with too many trtmnt cells? (for nulls?)
# effects = effects |> filter(is.na(n_trtmnt) | ((n_trtmnt <= max_prox_n_trtmnt*1.05) & (n_trtmnt >= min_prox_n_trtmnt*.95)) )

effects = effects |> filter(!is.na(pval))
```

# Plots (overall)

## Histogram of estimates and p-values

Histogram of estimates
```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height = 12}

plot_df = effects

p = ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = estimate, fill = method_long)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(..density..)), binwidth = .05) + # bins = 50) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = 'gray15', linewidth = .4) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 1), ylim = c(0, 3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 0:2, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .05))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_long_colors, guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(type), 
             rows = vars(method, NC_type, numNC),  # vars(method_long), # vars(method, NC_type, numNC), 
             scales = 'free') + 
  labs(title = 'Histogram of Estimates',
       fill = 'Method') +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), 
        panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines"),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0, "lines"))
p
ggsave(sprintf('%s/estimates_hist_tall.pdf', plot_dir), height = 12, width= 10)

```


## QQ-plots/Rejection Rates of p-values: Between Methods/Within Test Types


QQ-plot (basically)
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=7}
# the 'rejection_rate' column is also the 'theoretical' for the uniform (1/n, 2/n, ..., n/n)
plot_df = effects |> 
          group_by(type, method_long) |> 
          reframe(pval=sort(pval), count=sum(!is.na(pval)), rejection_rate = (1:count)/count) 

#----- p-values: qqplot vs uniform = rejection rate by pval threshold (all numNC)  ---------- 'pval_qqplot.pdf'
ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = pval, y = rejection_rate, color = method_long)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .4, alpha = .9, key_glyph = "rect") +
  geom_point(size=.2, alpha=.7, key_glyph = "rect") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1), labels = c('0', '.25', '.5', '.75', '1')) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_long_colors, guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) + #, labels = lapply(levels(plot_df$method_long), latex2exp::TeX)) +
  labs(title = 'Rejection Rate by P-value Threshold', 
       x = 'p-value threshold', y = 'rejection rate',
       color = 'Method') +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(type)) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.key.size = unit(.4, units = 'cm'))
ggsave(sprintf('%s/pval_qqplot.pdf', plot_dir), height = 3, width= 7)




#----- p-values: log10 qqplot -------------------------------------------------- 'pval_qqplot_log.pdf'
p = ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(y = -log(pval+(1e-500), base = 10), x = -log(rejection_rate+(1e-500), base = 10), color = method_long)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .4, alpha = .8, key_glyph = 'rect') +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = .7, key_glyph = 'rect', stroke=NA) +
  # scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2, 3.5)) +
  # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 200)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_long_colors, guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) + #, labels = lapply(levels(plot_df$method_long), latex2exp::TeX)) +
  labs(title = '-log(p-value) by -log(Unif(0,1))', 
       x = latex2exp::TeX('theoretical -$log_{10}$(Unif(0,1))'), y = latex2exp::TeX('sample -$log_{10}$(p-value)'),
       color = 'Method') +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(type), scales = 'free') + # facetted_pos_scales doesn't seem to work with facet_grid
  # facet_wrap(vars(type), ncol=1, scales = 'free', strip.position = "right") +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.key.size = unit(.4, units = 'cm'))
p

ggsave(sprintf('%s/pval_qqplot_log.pdf', plot_dir), height = 3, width= 7)



# use gg4x to set limits separately 
# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/72962172/custom-y-axis-breaks-of-facet-wrap/73006975#73006975
#----- p-values: log10 qqplot (Focus on same tail) ------------------------ 'pval_qqplot_log_tail1.pdf'
p + ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(
  x = list(
    type == 'Null'        ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2)),
    type == 'Alternative' ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2)),
    type == 'Discovery'   ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2))),
  y = list(
    type == 'Null'        ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 7), oob=scales::squish),
    type == 'Alternative' ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 7), oob=scales::squish),
    type == 'Discovery'   ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 7), oob=scales::squish))
  )

ggsave(sprintf('%s/pval_qqplot_log_tail1.pdf', plot_dir), height = 3, width= 7)


#----- p-values: log10 qqplot (Focus on different tails) ---------------------------------- 'pval_qqplot_log_tail2.pdf'
p + geom_line() + ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(
  x = list(
    type == 'Null'        ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)),
```

```{r}
# https://genome.sph.umich.edu/wiki/Code_Sample:_Generating_QQ_Plots_in_R
#this is a helper function to draw the confidence interval
panel.qqconf<-function(n, conf.points=1000, conf.col="gray", conf.alpha=.05, ...) {
	conf.points = min(conf.points, n-1);
	mpts<-matrix(nrow=conf.points*2, ncol=2)
	for(i in seq(from=1, to=conf.points)) {
    		mpts[i,1]<- -log10((i-.5)/n)
    		mpts[i,2]<- -log10(qbeta(1-conf.alpha/2, i, n-i))
    		mpts[conf.points*2+1-i,1]<- -log10((i-.5)/n)
    		mpts[conf.points*2+1-i,2]<- -log10(qbeta(conf.alpha/2, i, n-i))
	}
  # grid.polygon(x=mpts[,1],y=mpts[,2], gp=gpar(fill=conf.col, lty=0), default.units="native")
	return(mpts |> data.frame())
}
df_qqunif_ci = panel.qqconf(n=100, conf.points = 100, conf.alpha = .05)



# modified
panel.qqconf<-function(n=1000, alpha=.05, thin=NA) {
  
  all_ci_points = seq(from=1, to=n)
  if(is.na(thin)) { # all
    ci_points = all_ci_points
  } else { # should be integer, thin by every XX amount
    ci_points = unique(head(all_ci_points, 5),
                       all_ci_points[seq(from=1, to=length(all_ci_points), by = thin)], 
                       tail(all_ci_points, 5))
  }
  
  mpts<-matrix(nrow=length(ci_points)*2, ncol=2)
  
	for(i in seq(from=1, to=length(ci_points))) {
	  
  		mpts[i,1]                      <- -log10((ci_points[i]-.5)/n)
  		mpts[i,2]                      <- -log10(qbeta(1-alpha/2, ci_points[i], n-ci_points[i]))
  		mpts[length(ci_points)*2+1-i,1]<- -log10((ci_points[i]-.5)/n)
  		mpts[length(ci_points)*2+1-i,2]<- -log10(qbeta(alpha/2, ci_points[i], n-ci_points[i]))
	}
  
  
	return(mpts |> data.frame())
}

df_qqunif_ci = panel.qqconf(n=100, alpha = .05)

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data= panel.qqconf(n=10000, alpha = .05, thin=NA), mapping = aes(x=X1, y=X2), fill = 'gray', alpha=.5) +
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = 0, slope = 1))

ggplot(data=plot_df |> filter(method_long == 'Lin Reg')) +

  geom_line(aes(y=-log(pval+(1e-500), base = 10), 
                x = -log(rejection_rate+(1e-500))), color = 'blue') +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 7), y = c(0, 7)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(type))
```

```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=7}

make_qqplots <- function(prox_name, NC_type_) {
  
  prefix_ggsave = sprintf('%s_%s', prox_name, NC_type_)
  
  # the 'rejection_rate' column is also the 'theoretical' for the uniform (1/n, 2/n, ..., n/n)
  plot_df = effects |> 
            filter(method %in% c('lm', 'negbin', prox_name)) |> 
            filter(is.na(NC_type) | NC_type == NC_type_) |>
            group_by(type, method_long) |> 
            reframe(pval=sort(pval), count=sum(!is.na(pval)), rejection_rate = (1:count)/count) 
  
  #----- p-values: qqplot vs uniform = rejection rate by pval threshold (all numNC)  ---------- 'pval_qqplot.pdf'
  p1 = ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(x = pval, y = rejection_rate, color = method_long)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
    geom_line(linewidth = .4, alpha = .9, key_glyph = "rect") +
    geom_point(size=.2, alpha=.7, key_glyph = "rect") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, .25, .5, .75, 1), labels = c('0', '.25', '.5', '.75', '1')) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = method_long_colors, guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) + #, labels = lapply(levels(plot_df$method_long), latex2exp::TeX)) +
    labs(title = 'Rejection Rate by P-value Threshold', 
         x = 'p-value threshold', y = 'rejection rate',
         color = 'Method') +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(type)) +
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.key.size = unit(.4, units = 'cm'))
  p1
  ggsave(sprintf('%s/%s_pval_qqplot.pdf', plot_dir, prefix_ggsave), height = 3, width= 7)




  #----- p-values: log10 qqplot -------------------------------------------------- 'pval_qqplot_log.pdf'
  p2 = ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(y = -log(pval+(1e-500), base = 10), x = -log(rejection_rate+(1e-500), base = 10), color = method_long)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
    geom_line(linewidth = .4, alpha = .8, key_glyph = 'rect') +
    geom_point(size = 1, alpha = .7, key_glyph = 'rect', stroke=NA) +
    # scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2, 3.5)) +
    # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 200)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = method_long_colors, guide = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) + #, labels = lapply(levels(plot_df$method_long), latex2exp::TeX)) +
    labs(title = '-log(p-value) by -log(Unif(0,1))', 
         x = latex2exp::TeX('theoretical -$log_{10}$(Unif(0,1))'), y = latex2exp::TeX('sample -$log_{10}$(p-value)'),
         color = 'Method') +
    facet_grid(cols = vars(type), scales = 'free') + # facetted_pos_scales doesn't seem to work with facet_grid
    # facet_wrap(vars(type), ncol=1, scales = 'free', strip.position = "right") +
    theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.key.size = unit(.4, units = 'cm'))
  p2
  ggsave(sprintf('%s/%s_pval_qqplot_log.pdf', plot_dir, prefix_ggsave), height = 3, width= 7)



  # use gg4x to set limits separately 
  # https://stackoverflow.com/questions/72962172/custom-y-axis-breaks-of-facet-wrap/73006975#73006975
  #----- p-values: log10 qqplot (Focus on same tail) ------------------------ 'pval_qqplot_log_tail1.pdf'
  p3 = p2 + ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(
    x = list(
      type == 'Null'        ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2)),
      type == 'Alternative' ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2)),
      type == 'Discovery'   ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2))),
    y = list(
      type == 'Null'        ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 7), oob=scales::squish),
      type == 'Alternative' ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 7), oob=scales::squish),
      type == 'Discovery'   ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 7), oob=scales::squish))
    )
  p3
  ggsave(sprintf('%s/%s_pval_qqplot_log_tail1.pdf', plot_dir, prefix_ggsave), height = 3, width= 7)


  #----- p-values: log10 qqplot (Focus on different tails) ---------------------------------- 'pval_qqplot_log_tail2.pdf'
  p4 = p2 + geom_line() + ggh4x::facetted_pos_scales(
    x = list(
      type == 'Null'        ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)),
      type == 'Alternative' ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)),
      type == 'Discovery'   ~ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1))),
    y = list(
      type == 'Null'        ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3), oob=scales::squish),
      type == 'Alternative' ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3), oob=scales::squish),
      type == 'Discovery'   ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3), oob=scales::squish))
    )
  p4
  ggsave(sprintf('%s/%s_pval_qqplot_log_tail2.pdf', plot_dir, prefix_ggsave), height = 3, width= 7)
  
  return(list(p1, p2, p3, p4))

}
```

# Compare Causarray to 1 Proximal

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=8}

plot_df = merge(
      effects |> filter(method == 'proximallinear' & NC_type == 'singlegene' & numNC == 5), 
      effects |> filter(method == 'causarray') |> select(grna, gene, estimate, se, pval, padj), # the tests from causarray that are also tested in prox
      all.x = TRUE, all.y = FALSE,
      by = c('grna', 'gene'), 
      suffixes = c('.proximal', '.causarray')
)

plot_df = plot_df |> filter(!is.na(estimate.proximal) & !is.na(estimate.causarray))
plot_df = plot_df |> mutate(same_sign = (sign(estimate.proximal) == sign(estimate.causarray)))
plot_df = plot_df |> mutate(causarray_rej_padj = sapply(padj.causarray, 
                                                        FUN = function(x) {if(x < .05) {'reject'} else {'not reject'}}))

# head(plot_df)

ggplot(plot_df |> filter(type == 'Alternative'), 
       aes(x = estimate.causarray, y = estimate.proximal)) +
  geom_rect(data=data.frame(xmin = -Inf, xmax =   0, ymin =    0, ymax = Inf), 
            mapping=aes(xmin = xmin, xmax =   xmax, ymin =    ymin, ymax = ymax), 
            fill = scales::alpha("rosybrown1", .5), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_rect(data=data.frame(xmin =    0, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax =   0), 
            mapping=aes(xmin = xmin, xmax =   xmax, ymin =    ymin, ymax = ymax),
            fill = scales::alpha("rosybrown1", .5), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_abline(aes(slope = 1, intercept = 0), linetype = 'dashed', linewidth = .5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",  linewidth = .5, color = 'black', fullrange = TRUE, fill = 'grey80') +
  geom_point(aes(shape = same_sign, color = causarray_rej_padj), alpha = .9, size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(4, 16), guide='none') +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1.2, 1.8), expand=c(0, 0)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c('gray20', 'purple2')) +
  labs(x = 'Causarray log2 Fold Change Estimate', y='Proximal Average Treatment Effect Estimate', 
       title = 'Causarray vs Proximal ATE Estimates for Alternative Tests', 
       subtitle = 'Proximal using singlegene as NCs with 5 NC pairs', 
       color = TeX('causarray reject after multiple testing correction at $alpha$=.05')) +
  theme(legend.position = 'top', 
        legend.justification = "center")


ggsave(sprintf('%s/estimate_causarray_vs_prox_singlegene5.pdf', plot_dir), height = 6, width= 8)

```
